title: Create Data Collector Set Using Template

facts.text: Business Central data collector set template is an XML file named DataCollectorSet.xml installed with Server in the Service folder.
Create new Data Collector Set from template by opening Performance Monitor, expanding Data Collector Sets, and selecting User-defined.
Browse to DataCollectorSet.xml template location, typically in the Service folder, and follow wizard instructions to complete setup.
Data collected by collector set is stored in log file viewable in Performance Monitor.
